The bottom image shows three women walking down a street, each engrossed in their smartphones, with the text 'not this,' suggesting a modern, passive, or disconnected lifestyle. The overall intent is to humorously contrast a more 'authentic' or 'active' past with a perceived 'lazy' or 'distracted' present, using the smartphone culture as a target. The meme does not contain any toxic elements such as abusive, cyberbullying, harmful, hateful, misogynous, or propaganda content. It is a lighthearted, self-deprecating or observational commentary on generational shifts in social behavior, specifically the contrast between analog social interaction and digital distraction. The intent is to evoke nostalgia and humor by mapping the visual of shared, physical interaction (top) against the visual of individual, digital engagement (bottom), using the text to frame the contrast as a positive reflection on the past versus a negative portrayal of the present.
